findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_campaign_draft, submit_posted_video · Private data: get_service_info, create_campaign_draft, estimate_campaign, create_campaign_order, check_campaign_status, list_my_campaigns, submit_posted_video, list_my_deliverables · Public sink: create_campaign_draft, create_campaign_order, list_my_campaigns, submit_posted_video, list_my_deliverables.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_campaign_draft, submit_posted_video · Private data: get_service_info, create_campaign_draft, estimate_campaign, create_campaign_order, check_campaign_status, list_my_campaigns, submit_posted_video, list_my_deliverables · Public sink: create_campaign_draft, create_campaign_order, list_my_campaigns, submit_posted_video, list_my_deliverables

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
